    level="1"
    right="Feat 4"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Tactile Magic Feedback](/Feats.aspx?ID=5453) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 70

**Archetype** [Ostilli Host](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=222)

**Prerequisites**
[Ostilli Host Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5451)

</column>

---

Your ostilli can sense nearby spellcasters. You gain an [imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412) sense known as spellsense, which has a range of 60 feet and detects only creatures capable of casting spells (including creatures with innate spells). You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=2367) checks about creatures you're detecting with spellsense.
